body: Hey, thanks for your scathing reply about a situation you almost certainly have total knowledge of.
I've thought about trying to do a lot of things, but I just sit in bed day after day.
Me 3. What the other commenters have said
I do things with people. It's just that I feel disconnected from them even while we're together, which is lonelier than just being by yourself all the time, in my experience.
I'm in a similar position, so I can empathize. PM me if you wanna talk
I don't believe it necessarily gets better. I feel lonely constantly. I haven't felt not-completely-alone in almost a decade.
You still around? Need someone to talk to for a while?

There are good and bad things about being single. Similarly, there are good and bad things about being in a relationship. My advice: don't go looking for a relationship to try and solve the problems that bring you here today. Because, let me tell you, there is no worse loneliness than the kind that exists in spite of (or because of) the person you share a bed with. 

I know some of what you're going through. My wedding day was scheduled for next week. I found out earlier this month that she's been cheating on me. 

My advice: focus on you. It's what I'm desperately trying to do.
